sentences.text:
Mahendra Singh vs State Of Rajasthan Through Pp on 4 July,
2018
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan

S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 56
 Mahendra Singh
 
 Versus
 State Of Rajasthan Through Pp
 -

For Petitioner(s) : Mr. R.B. Sharma (Ganthola) For Respondent(s) : Mr. Prakash Thakuria, P.P.
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kanwaljit Singh Ahluwalia / Order 04/07/2018

The learned
counsel for the petitioner has submitted that in view of the provisions of Food Safety and Standards
Act, 2006, Fir is not maintainable and the proceedings are liable to be quashed.
Issue notice to the respondent for 12.09.2018.
The learned Public Prosecutor is directed to call the Investigating Officer in this Court along with Food Inspector to show cause as to how the FIR is maintainable.
Meanwhile, further proceedings arising out of the impugned FIR are stayed.
A copy of this order under the seal and signature of the Court Master be handed over to the learned Public Prosecutor for onward transmission and necessary compliance.
